exercises.question: Which sentence combines a problem with a relative clause? [¿Cuál combina un problema con una oración de relativo?]
options: Hay un atasco que impide que los autobuses lleguen a tiempo. [There is a traffic jam that prevents buses from arriving on time.]
Hay un atasco. [There is a traffic jam.]
Los autobuses llegan. [The buses arrive.]

exercises.sentence: El problema se agravó __ no se actuó a tiempo. (porque) [The problem got worse because action was not taken in time.]

exercises.english: It is necessary that we address the cause of the problem.

sentences: El sistema dejó de funcionar de repente. [The system suddenly stopped working.]
Nadie sabía la causa exacta. [Nobody knew the exact cause.]
Finalmente, un técnico encontró el problema. [Finally, a technician found the problem.]

exercises.question: Which expression introduces a hypothetical condition? [¿Cuál introduce una condición hipotética?]
options: si tuviéramos [if we had]
por lo tanto [therefore]
además [furthermore]

exercises.sentence: Si la primera solución no __, buscaría una alternativa. (funcionar) [If the first solution did not work, I would look for an alternative.]

exercises.english: A quick change would avoid further damage.

exercises.question: Which sentence contains a recommendation with the subjunctive? [¿Cuál contiene una recomendación con subjuntivo?]
options: Conviene que se adopten medidas antes del invierno. [It is advisable that measures be adopted before winter.]
Se adoptaron medidas antes del invierno. [Measures were adopted before winter.]
Se adoptarán medidas antes del invierno. [Measures will be adopted before winter.]

exercises.sentence: La falta de mantenimiento desencadenó varios fallos.
options: The lack of maintenance triggered several failures.
The lack of maintenance solved several failures.
The lack of maintenance had no effect.

exercises.sentence: El equipo técnico resolvería el fallo pronto.
options: The technical team would resolve the fault soon.
The technical team resolved the fault yesterday.
The technical team will never resolve it.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que resolvamos esto cuanto antes.

options: La falta de mantenimiento los desencadenó. [The lack of maintenance triggered them.]
La falta de mantenimiento fue una alternativa. [The lack of maintenance was an alternative.]
La falta de mantenimiento sería una prioridad mañana. [The lack of maintenance would be a priority tomorrow.]
Es necesario que abordemos la causa del problema. [It is necessary that we address the cause of the problem.]
Es necesario que abordamos la causa del problema. [It is necessary that we address the cause of the problem.]
Es necesario que abordaríamos la causa del problema. [It is necessary that we would address the cause of the problem.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué harías si la solución no funcionara?

options: Buscaría una alternativa. [I would look for an alternative.]
Busqué una alternativa mañana. [I looked for an alternative tomorrow.]
Buscaré una alternativa ayer. [I will look for an alternative yesterday.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines problem, cause and response? [¿Cuál combina problema, causa y respuesta?]
options: El problema se agravó porque no se actuó a tiempo, por eso es necesario que abordemos su causa. [The problem got worse because action was not taken in time, so it is necessary that we address its cause.]
El problema existe. [The problem exists.]
Hay una solución. [There is a solution.]

template.prompt: Explain a problem, its cause and one necessary action.
template.answer: El problema se agravó porque no se actuó a tiempo, por eso es necesario que abordemos su causa.
La primera alternativa parece útil; sin embargo, sería difícil aplicarla. En conclusión, debemos elegir una solución viable.
